title: Pick the agent for a task without naming one
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. 'susi run "<task>"' chooses swarm or an external agent from evidence, cost and privacy; naming an agent is an override. Tests zc_agent_pick_*.
